**1. What shipping options are available?**

Here are the shipping options our store offers, along with delivery times, costs, and free shipping eligibility (source: [faq_shipping.md / 1. Shipping Options & Timelines]):

**1. Standard Shipping:**
- Estimated delivery: 4–7 business days
- Cost: ₹49–₹99 (varies by order weight and location)
- Free on orders above ₹499

**2. Express Shipping:**
- Estimated delivery: 1–3 business days
- Cost: ₹99–₹199 (varies by order weight and location)
- Available in metros and Tier-1 cities

**3. Same-Day Delivery:**
- Available in select cities: Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai
- Order must be placed before 12:00 PM for same-day delivery
- Cost: ₹149 flat
- Not available for all product categories

**4. Scheduled Delivery:**
- Choose a preferred delivery date and time slot (morning/afternoon/evening)
- Available for large items (furniture, appliances) in select areas
- Cost: Included with product or ₹199 for general items

**Free Shipping Eligibility:**
- Automatically applied on orders above ₹499 (standard shipping only)
- If you have an active premium membership (OurStore Plus), you get unlimited free standard shipping with no minimum order value ([faq_shipping.md / Q2.3])
- Free shipping can also be applied if a coupon, promotion, or seller-specific campaign is available ([faq_shipping.md / Q2.2])

All available shipping options and their costs are shown at checkout, based on your location and cart contents. Express and same-day delivery carry a charge even if your order qualifies for free standard shipping.

---

**2. When do I get free shipping?**

Free shipping is available under these conditions:

- Your **order subtotal exceeds ₹499** (for standard shipping).
- You have an active **premium membership** (Prime/Plus/OurStore Plus), which gives you free shipping on all orders regardless of value.
- If you apply a **free shipping coupon** or participate in a relevant promotion.
- When a **seller is running a free shipping promotion** on specific products.

**Important Notes:**
- Free shipping only applies to the standard delivery method.
- Express and same-day delivery always have a charge.
- At checkout, all available shipping options and eligibility will be shown for your location and cart.

(Source: [faq_shipping.md / Q2.2: How do I get free shipping?] and [faq_shipping.md / Q2.3: Does your premium membership include free shipping?])
reference: Two main options: Standard Shipping (4–7 business days, ₹49–₹99, free on orders above ₹499) and Express Shipping (1–3 business days, ₹99–₹199, available in metros and Tier-1 cities). Free shipping applies automatically on standard orders over ₹499.

If your tracking shows "Delivered" but you haven't received your package, here's what you should do:

1. **Check your surroundings** — Look to see if a neighbor or family member accepted it, or if it was left behind a door, in a mailbox, or with your building reception.
2. **Check within 24 hours** — Sometimes the delivery agent marks it delivered upon leaving it at your door or lobby.
3. **Contact the courier directly** — Use your tracking number to call the courier partner’s helpline and ask for the delivery agent’s details.
4. If you still don’t have your package after 24–48 hours, **contact our support** with your order number. We will:
   - Review GPS/proof of delivery submitted by the courier.
   - Raise a formal dispute with the logistics partner.
   - Issue a replacement or refund if the package cannot be located within 5 business days.

(Source: [faq_shipping.md / Q3.3])

response:
You can change your delivery address after you've placed an order, but only **before the order is dispatched**.  

To do so:
1. Go to **My Orders → [Order] → Edit Address**.
2. Enter or select the new delivery address.
3. Click **"Save"** — the change will be reflected in your order.

**After dispatch:** Address changes are typically not possible once the package is with the courier. If your order has already shipped, contact support immediately at support@ourstore.com with your order number. In some cases, we can request the courier to redirect the package, but this is not guaranteed and may add 1–3 days to delivery. If delivery fails due to an incorrect address, the package will be returned to our warehouse and you'll receive a refund, minus the shipping cost in some cases.

(Source: [faq_shipping.md / 4. Address Management & Changes])
